result.stdout:
rabbit-mcp: MCP server for RabbitMQ, built on message contracts.

usage: rabbit-mcp
         Runs the MCP server, normally started by an MCP client (stdio; RabbitMcp__Transport=http serves HTTP).
         Options are RabbitMcp__* environment variables: https://github.com/lazogio/rabbit-mcp#configuration
       rabbit-mcp --version
       rabbit-mcp contracts diff <old> <new> [--json]
         Compares two versions of the contracts (a [MessageContract] DLL or an AsyncAPI .yaml/.json file).
         Exit code: 0 compatible, 1 breaking changes, 2 error.
       rabbit-mcp contracts asyncapi <contracts> [--title NAME]
         Writes the contracts as an AsyncAPI 3.0 document (JSON) to stdout.
